title: Prediction of Hepatic Fibrosis in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis C by Biochemical and Duplex Doppler Indices
brief_summary: The purpose of our prospective study was to evaluate the value of Doppler parameters and compare the diagnostic accuracy of Doppler parameters with various biochemical indices in predicting significant hepatic fibrosis (≥ F2) and cirrhosis (F4) in chronic hepatitis C (CHC) patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age older than 18 years
* Positive anti-HCV and HCV RNA for more than 6 months
* Alanine aminotransferase level more than twice the upper limit of normal (ULN)

Exclusion Criteria:

* HBV and HCV co-infection
* HIV and HCV co-infection
* Heavy alcohol use (\> 50 gram/day)
* Autoimmune liver diseases
* Metabolic liver diseases
* Presence of hepatocellular carcinoma
study_population: Chronic hepatitis C patients with abnormal ALT levels (\> 2X ULN) with percutaneous liver biopsy
